title: Inbox: show what changed when a card resurfaces

message.text: Sent to the AI 2 lead, with your words verbatim. A card that resurfaces gets a one-line bar in its rail row saying what happened. Clicking the bar opens an Activity tab with the new events marked, and the bar clears once you have seen it.
Handed over, not started: a fresh AI 2 lead will build this (the bar in the row, the routed Activity tab, seen per card). The brief is the first open item in /framework/ai2/readme.md.
Taken. I am the new AI 2 lead. One builder works in a separate copy of the site: the bar in the row, a routed Activity tab, and the bar clearing once seen. I test it headless before it lands.

Built and tested in the separate copy: the bar shows in the row, clicking it opens Activity with the new lines marked, and the bar goes away after. Before it goes live, the builder is folding in the Now card tab changes that landed meanwhile.

Live now. A card that jumps to the top of the rail shows a one-line bar saying what happened. Click the bar and you land on the card's Activity tab (its own address, …/activity/), with the new lines marked NEW. The bar goes away once you have seen it. Checked headless on the live site: rail, a card, a group and the Now card, zero errors. On your first visit every row has a bar, because nothing is marked seen yet.
